app.name: Owen's Minigames
app.long_description:
Owen's Minigames: ten short games for the Wii Remote.
Balloon Pop, Target Practice, Whack-a-Mole, Fruit Catcher, Memory Match, Dodge It!, Fishing Frenzy, Bubble Pop, Racing Challenge and Treasure Hunt.
Point the Wii Remote at the screen (sensor bar needed) or use the +Control Pad. Press HOME to pause or quit.
